adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new cook path where `Post#cook` returns `raw` verbatim when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html` using third-party `contents` from RSS/remote HTML (app/models/topic_embed.rb; app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), so any untrusted HTML is stored/rendered as-is. The embed UI renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), making stored XSS feasible. Additionally, feed fetching uses `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` (open-uri) and may be plain HTTP, increasing injection risk via MITM as described.
